description: This file implements the Azure Speech-to-Text service for the Pipecat project. It defines the AzureSTTService class, which leverages the Azure Cognitive Services Speech SDK to perform real-time speech recognition, handle audio streams, and process recognition events. The class includes methods to initialize the service, manage recognition lifecycle, process audio data, handle recognition results, and integrate with tracing and metrics. It references several internal modules for frames, utilities, and common Azure configurations, and interacts with external Azure SDK modules for speech recognition.

classes.name: AzureSTTService
classes.description: A service class implementing speech-to-text functionality using Azure Cognitive Services. Handles initialization, audio stream management, event callbacks, and recognition control for real-time transcription.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, region: str, language: Language = Language.EN_US, sample_rate: Optional[int] = None, endpoint_id: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Returns True, indicating this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes chunks of audio data, writes them to the audio stream for recognition, and manages related metrics and error handling.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Sets up the Azure speech recognizer, initializes audio streams, and begins continuous recognition.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops recognition, terminates the recognizer, and closes audio streams.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Immediately cancels ongoing recognition and closes resources.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
methods.description: Handles finalized transcription results, including metric management and tracing decorations.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognized(self, event)
methods.description: Callback invoked when Azure SDK recognizes speech; processes recognized text and passes to transcription handler.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognizing(self, event)
methods.description: Callback invoked during ongoing recognition to handle interim results.
